ref.quote: Zip bulk upload: it always creates new categories from the zip's folders (optionally under parent_category_id); it can't upload into an existing category. The cap applies to each new category, so it can be tested with one folder holding more files than the cap. The upload is accepted, the extra files are skipped, each with a line in logs like Failed - <path> - The category allows up to 5 items, and the bulk upload ends as done.
